poses.label: Reach
poses.description: Brace one hand and the same-side knee on the bench, plant your other foot, and let the dumbbell hang from your free hand.

poses.label: Pull
poses.description: Drive your working elbow back, keeping your torso steady.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Bring the dumbbell toward your hip without twisting your torso.

poses.label: Return
poses.description: Lower until your arm straightens, then repeat on the other side after your set.

checks: Compared the supported setup and controlled return with Mayo Clinic. Used the ThoeneFit cue for the hip-directed path and fixed torso.
Validated joint ranges, equipment anchors, contact and framing through the complete loop.
limitations: The loop demonstrates one side. The written cue covers switching sides.
Fit-test playback and screen-size review are pending integration.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
